She Flies: A student pilot turns up the mic. 🎙️✈️

Sanya Bhalla first took the controls of a Cessna 172 at 13 through the Smithsonian’s Aviation Explorers program. Now the Fairfax County high school senior is training out of Manassas Regional Airport and working toward her first solo.

She’s also the voice behind She Flies, a podcast that gives girls a chance to hear how women got their start in aviation. One guest, Shaesta Waiz, flew solo around the world in a single-engine airplane. Other conversations explore careers in maintenance, engineering and air traffic control.

There’s more than one way into aviation. Sanya is making it easier for the next kid to hear where to start.

Sources: Patch, Nov. 18, 2026, and the She Flies podcast.
